# Transmit Startups

> A UK-based startup support platform providing business loans, mentoring, coaching, and educational resources to help entrepreneurs launch and grow their ventures.

Transmit Startups offers comprehensive support for business founders through Start Up Loans paired with expert mentoring, online courses, and strategic guidance. Based in Gateshead, the organization combines financial support with educational resources and entrepreneurial coaching to enable startup success across the UK.

## Key Topics

- Start Up Loans
- Business Mentoring
- Startup Funding
- Entrepreneurial Coaching
- Online Courses
- Business Planning
- Startup Finance
- Smarta Coaches
- Business Support

- Entrepreneur Support
- Business Growth
- Gateshead
- UK Startups
- EdTech
